title: Exponential Deterministic Query Complexity of Goldstein Stationarity
summary: We study the deterministic query complexity of finding approximate Goldstein stationary points of globally Lipschitz functions that may be nonsmooth and nonconvex. Under prescribed bounds on the Lipschitz constant and on the difference between the initial function value and the infimum, we prove a lower bound on the worst-case number of oracle calls that is exponential in the dimension at fixed sufficiently small accuracy parameters.
